# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This project uses `AGENTS.md` as the single source of truth for AI coding agents.

Please read the full project guidance in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).

Key points for this repository:
- New blog posts belong in `_articles/<slug>.md` (not `posts/`)
- The 26 legacy posts under `posts/` must never have their file paths changed
- Use the hybrid collection model described in AGENTS.md
